verdict.rationale: Quo documents call recording, with recorded calls coming back transcribed and summarized. Call history and transcripts can be retrieved later with filters through its MCP integration. Nothing in the evidence addresses consent handling or jurisdiction-specific recording rules, and retrieval is shown only for transcripts and call history, not the audio recordings themselves. Missing for 10: consent announcements or jurisdiction-aware consent controls, documented search and playback of the recording audio, and in-depth recording docs or independent corroboration.
